thread:
anya: deploy-bot reports increased OOMs and tail latency on embeddings in eu-west1 after last quant rollout. I have a small hotfix that reverts the allocator change + raises pod memory to 6Gi (v2.3.3-hotfix). Need quick signoff to pin and canary. change window active (45m left).

deploy-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service eu-west1: OOMs=28 (10m), 5xx rate x4, p95 latency +180ms. Suggested action: release redwood/embeddings:2.3.3-hotfix. Canary plan: 3% -> 30% -> 100% (fast-roll if signals stable). Approvals required: duty-officer, infra, se.

sam: can we avoid global rollout? recommend pin to eu-west1-dedicated pool and keep other regions on v2.3.2.

rohan: ops can carve 2 reserved nodes in eu-west1-dedicated and mute autoscale. I can do that now.

ops: reserved 2 nodes, autoscale off for 1h. ingress pinned for canary route.

anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/912 7 patch, changelog updated: "Fix: revert allocator tweak causing memory growth; increase memory headroom for embeddings." Also added rollback steps.

ingrid: smoke tests ready, I can run `./scripts/smoke.sh --region eu-west1 --service embeddings` (runs ~4m).

sam: define rollback criteria here: revert if OOMs >0 in canary for 10m OR p95 increases >200ms vs baseline OR error rate >1%. Agree?

duty-officer: that sounds reasonable. I can approve 3% canary now if infra and se ack.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY REQUEST: user=anya, action=canary-rollout, image=redwood/embeddings:2.3.3-hotfix, fraction=3%, region=eu-west1. Pending approvals: duty-officer, infra, se.

rohan: infra ack. reserved nodes in place.

sam: se ack. ran quick staging smoke earlier. +1.

duty-officer: approved for 3% canary. proceed and monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 3% traffic. Telemetry: first 8m: OOMs=0, p95 within baseline+20ms, error rate <0.2%. Scheduling bump to 30% in 12m if stable.

anya: running smoke now and tailing logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embeddings -f --since=10m | grep -i oom` nothing so far.

ingrid: observed a minor GC spike at ~3m, not causing errors.

rohan: ops will keep rollback playbook ready. If we hit criteria, we will pin traffic back and trigger `kubectl rollout undo`.

deploy-bot: ROLL DECISION: Voting window open for 10m after 30% holds. React with :thumbsup: to fast-track to 100%.

sam: :+1: fast-track when 30% stable.

ingrid: :+1: staging and canary look green.

anya: prepping final release note and will cut the release tag after full rollout. changelog link in PR.

deploy-bot: Fast-track noted. Target plan: 30% -> hold 15m -> 100% if no regressions. Final update in thread when rollout completes or if rollback triggered.
